speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will read the post on the way to the door, and I will come back through this one. I am not taking the yard as a short cut.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Then take the post and leave my stair as a stair. If you come back painted, come back after the doors, not before them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The second line is the company. That is all the post owes you. Read it and be done.
